phase_policies.applies_when: At the start of the game, both players have limited information. The opponent's posture is unknown, and your own production and technology are light or uncertain.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's composition or when you reach a key timing.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and technology with safety checks; if a Reaper is spotted, strengthen ground forces and increase production.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path, focusing on economy and technology. Avoid unnecessary risks.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to economy and technology while ignoring a Reaper threat, leaving workers vulnerable.

phase_policies.applies_when: As the game progresses into the early-midgame, the opponent's posture remains unknown, but you have had time to develop your economy and technology.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's first combat units or when you have a better read on their strategy.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain development with safety checks; if opponent shows ground army, consider defensive structures and counter units.
phase_policies.target: Continue maintaining your current development path, focusing on economy and technology. Keep your options open.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect your economy while building an army, or overcommit to a single unit composition without adaptability.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the midgame, the opponent's posture is still unknown, but you have had time to build up your economy and technology.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's first combat units or when you have a better read on their strategy.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain development with safety checks; if opponent has ground army, strengthen ground forces and consider supporting units.
phase_policies.target: Continue maintaining your current development path, focusing on economy and technology. Keep your options open.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect your economy while building an army, or overcommit to a single unit composition without adaptability.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late midgame, the opponent has a strong ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, and Medivacs. Your own posture is unknown and underdeveloped.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a stronger army or when you have more information about the opponent's intentions.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain development while preparing defense; consider defensive structures or units to counter opponent's composition.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your current development path, but be aware that you are behind. Consider building a defensive structure or a unit to counter the opponent's composition.
phase_policies.title: Late Midgame Ground Macro
phase_policies.veto: Do not engage the opponent's army without a plan, or neglect your economy while trying to catch up.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
